webhooks.detail: Ads webhooks on ad_account object: subscribe app to ad_account fields, connect ad accounts; 88+ notification types (ad object, insights, effective_status changes).

evidence.quote: You subscribe your app to one or more `ad_account` fields, then connect the specific ad accounts you manage.

sandbox.detail: Free Sandbox Ad Account in app dashboard; no payment method, ads don't run, mock performance reports. Sandbox token valid ~2 months.

evidence.quote: These ad accounts don't require a payment method and the ads you create won't run.

rate_limits.summary: Per ad account, score-based: read=1, write=3 pts; max 60 (dev) / 9000 (full access), 300s decay. Plus BUC hourly quotas, 100 QPS on create/edit.

evidence.quote: Rate limiting is at the ad account level.
